blocks.text: “Forgotten Island” lead stars Liza Soberano and H.E.R. made a guest appearance at the American morning show “Today” where they spoke about their Filipino roots as well as the Filipino representation in the animation film. Soberano—who marked her debut guesting in the program—expressed pride and delight over the DreamWorks film, saying it makes Filipinos “feel seen.” “It’s so emotional and overwhelming. It just brings us so much pride and joy to finally have something that represents our culture and makes us feel seen,” she said during the show’s episode aired on Tuesday, Sept. 22. “I couldn’t be more ecstatic to be […]...
